_note: Rule SKELETONS. Values are unresolved (to_be_confirmed) until supplied by the Requirements Resolver from cited documents. Never treat as fact.

instruction.NSW: Obtain the s10.7 planning certificate (EP&A Act) for the lot and confirm with the council.
instruction.QLD: Obtain the council property/planning report (and check the SARA DA mapping) for the lot.

rules.title: Flood-affected lot
next_steps: Request flood certificate / flood information from council
Engage a flood engineer if required by council
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: DA with flood assessment; verify with council
rules.source: to be cited from flood development control plan / planning scheme overlay code

rules.title: Bushfire prone land (habitable building)
next_steps: Commission a BAL assessment (AS 3959) by an accredited practitioner
NSW: check Planning for Bushfire Protection (habitable buildings)
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: BAL construction requirements for a habitable building; verify with council / certifier
rules.source: to be cited from Planning for Bushfire Protection / AS 3959 / NCC

rules.title: Bushfire prone land (Class 10a non-habitable shed)
next_steps: Confirm whether bushfire construction requirements apply to a Class 10a building at this location (they differ from habitable buildings)
Confirm any separation distance from a dwelling or boundary
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: bushfire requirements for a Class 10a building differ from habitable buildings; verify with council / certifier
rules.source: to be cited from Planning for Bushfire Protection / AS 3959 / NCC

rules.title: Bushfire prone land
next_steps: Commission a BAL assessment (AS 3959) by an accredited practitioner
NSW: check Planning for Bushfire Protection; integrated development may need an RFS bush fire safety authority
QLD: check State Planning Policy bushfire hazard
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: integrated development / referral; verify with council
rules.source: to be cited from Planning for Bushfire Protection (NSW) / State Planning Policy (QLD) / AS 3959

rules.title: Heritage
next_steps: Prepare a heritage impact statement
Seek pre-lodgement advice from council heritage adviser
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: DA required, possible referral; verify with council
rules.source: to be cited from LEP heritage clause / planning scheme heritage code

rules.title: Acid sulfate soils
next_steps: Confirm class and works depth thresholds
Prepare an ASS management plan if works disturb affected soil
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: consent for works below mapped level; verify with council
rules.source: to be cited from LEP ASS clause / SPP acid sulfate soils

rules.title: Biodiversity
next_steps: Engage an accredited assessor to determine whether a BDAR / ecological assessment is needed
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: referral / offsets; verify with council
rules.source: to be cited from Biodiversity Conservation Act (NSW) / MSES guidelines (QLD)

rules.title: Airport noise / obstacles
next_steps: Confirm obstacle limitation surface height and ANEF contour with the airport/council
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: referral to airport operator; verify with council
rules.source: to be cited from LEP airport clause / AS 2021

rules.title: Secondary dwelling approval pathway
next_steps: Check whether exempt or complying development may apply to this lot and design (verify with council / accredited certifier)
If not, a development application is likely required
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: complying development or DA; verify with council / certifier
rules.source: to be cited from the State planning policy for secondary dwellings and the LEP/DCP

rules.title: Secondary dwelling services connection
next_steps: Contact the water authority about sewer and water capacity and connection
Contact the electricity distributor about connection and metering
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: authority approval / certificate before occupation; verify with the authorities
rules.source: to be cited from the water authority and distributor requirements

rules.title: Shed (Class 10a outbuilding) approval pathway
next_steps: Check whether exempt development may apply (size, height, setback, easement conditions) - verify with council / certifier
If not, complying development or a DA may be needed
rules.development_pathway_hint: may apply: exempt or complying development; verify with council / certifier
rules.source: to be cited from the State exempt and complying development code and the LEP/DCP

rules.title: Mapped constraint
next_steps: Obtain the authoritative statement of what this layer triggers

_dev_note: Rules with development_types apply only to those types; layers [] = evaluated from the development type alone. All values unresolved until cited.
